environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with pgBouncer 1.21 configured in session pooling mode with prepared statement support (server_lifetime=300, max_prepared_statements=100). The pgBouncer instance has a custom query_rewrite hook compiled via c-module extension that enforces a content-type allowlist on parameterized values matching the pattern for theme_preference column updates — specifically, values written to theme_preference pass through pgBouncer's protocol-level prepared statement binding where the parameter type is cast as a validated CSS color token (regex ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$|^[a-z]{3,20}$) before being forwarded to PostgreSQL. This is implemented via pgBouncer's auth_query integration with a PL/pgSQL validation trigger on the users table that rejects any theme_preference value not matching the CSS color pattern, combined with a PostgreSQL CHECK constraint on the column.

config.db_trigger: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger validates theme_preference against CSS color regex
